prompt: ¿Cómo fluyen los datos desde que un usuario invoca /research-codebase hasta que se genera el documento final en thoughts/? Quiero entender todos los componentes que intervienen.

assertions.text: Describes the flow including at least: invocation with arguments, decomposition of the research question, spawning sub-agents, waiting for results, synthesis, and writing to thoughts/shared/research/
Identifies that research-codebase depends on thoughts-management for directory initialization (thoughts-init script) and/or metadata generation (thoughts-metadata script)
Mentions the correct output path: thoughts/shared/research/ with YYYY-MM-DD naming convention
Mentions at least one of the scripts: thoughts-init or thoughts-metadata, located in core/skills/thoughts-management/scripts/
Identifies at least one cross-plugin connection: research-codebase (core) can optionally use web-search-researcher (web plugin) for external research
